document_role: The source contains nineteenth-century scholarship and no instructions directed at this project.

primary_source.citation: Schwab, Moïse. ‘Coupes à inscriptions magiques.’ Proceedings of the Society of Biblical Archaeology 13 (1891): 583–595.

corroborating_source.finding: Montgomery independently indexes N, O, and P as three bowls in the Dieulafoy collection from Susiana.

findings: Schwab states that the French mission of M. and Mme Dieulafoy in Susiana brought three such bowls to France.
The three bowls are individually designated N, O, and P and are distinguished by diameter and textual description.
The contemporary report supports an excavation-mission evidence basis but supplies no trench, building, layer, or other precise archaeological context.
No current museum accession numbers were established in this review.
